actToday.title: H5N1 bird flu reported on the Peninsula and Phillip Island
actToday.description: MP News reports bird flu detected on the Peninsula on 12 August. The Shire’s current notice says H5N1 has been detected in Victoria and says people should avoid contact with sick or dead birds and report observations to DEECA or the Emergency Animal Disease Hotline (1800 675 888).
actToday.interpretation: High-utility safety information, but use only the Shire/DEECA guidance. Do not extend the reported location or make claims beyond the official advice.
actToday.recommendation: Telegram PI group + safety/hub update, subject to human editorial approval.
